note: Cabin and RV park at I-90 exit 34, two miles from Sturgis, across the road from the Bulldog Creek trailhead into the Black Hills National Forest (hiking, biking and UTV trails). Grass sites with crushed-asphalt pads, a heated pool, hot tub, bar and grill, and camp store. No campfires at sites (community fire pit) and no generators. Sturgis Rally week has its own rates and rules. --Claude
